pkgmetadata.longdescription: NordVPN client for Linux, repackaged from the official .deb: the nordvpn command-line tool, the nordvpnd system daemon it drives (OpenRC init script always, systemd units with USE=systemd) and the NordLynx, OpenVPN and NordWhisper technologies. Only members of the nordvpn group can control the daemon. Needs a NordVPN subscription.
